ADVANCED VISIBILITY. PROFESSIONAL CONTROL.

ClearView Pro is the most capable version of the ClearView camera family, combining real-time visibility enhancement with high-resolution capture, video recording and advanced manual controls.
Enhance fog, haze, rain and low-contrast scenes while maintaining direct control over how the image is processed.

PRO FEATURES
-Real-time visibility enhancement
-Fog and haze reduction
-Low-contrast detail enhancement
-UHD capture on supported devices
-Video recording
-Advanced processing controls
-Multiple camera/lens support
-Live camera preview
-On-device processing
-No cloud required
-No subscription

ClearView Pro is designed for photographers, videographers, outdoor users and professionals who need greater control when capturing challenging scenes.

Capture more. Control more. Reveal more.
